candidates.title: TokenStack: A Heterogeneous HBM-PIM Architecture and Runtime for Efficient LLM Inference
candidates.reason: HBM4 stack内をdense capacity層とPIM-enabled層に分け、base-die controllerでKV移動・address translation・inline quantizationを管理するKV-centric architecture/runtime。production-derived traceでtoken throughput 1.62倍、SLO-compliant capacity 1.70倍、energy/token 30–47%削減を報告し、階層メモリとnear-memory KV管理の重点系統に強く該当する。

candidates.title: NOVA: Technology-Architecture Co-Design of Near-Memory Processing for Attention-SSM-MoE Hybrid LLM Inference
candidates.reason: GQA/SSM/MoE混成LLMの異なる演算強度に対し、peri-dieとbase-dieの2-tier near-memory processingを割り当てるtechnology-architecture co-design。Qwen3等で平均throughput 4.5倍、end-to-end latency 69.8%削減、energy efficiency 5倍を報告し、MoEと階層near-memory executionを横断する比較価値が高い。

candidates.title: StreamDQ: Near-Memory Weight DeQuantization in Custom HBM for Scalable AI Inference Acceleration
candidates.reason: HBM base dieへ軽量dequantization blockを置き、GPU側CUDA coreでのweight dequantizationと余分なHBM trafficを除く。end-to-end LLM inferenceでlatency最大54.68%削減、decode throughput最大2.20倍を報告し、memory-side computeの実装比較として有用。
